Known violations of scripts/check-versioning-cell.mjs (srs#649), same discipline as scripts/spec-coherence-allowlist.json and scripts/publication-reachability-exclusions.json. Entry shape: {path, id, fromCommit, toCommit, disposition, issue, note}. `path`/`id` name the Field, `fromCommit`/`toCommit` (7+ hex chars, prefix-matched) pin the exact historical transition so a distinct future violation on the same Field is never silently absorbed. `disposition` is "permanent" (a ruled, settled outcome — closure of `issue` is expected) or "pending" (real follow-up remains — `issue` should still be open). The check fails on any violation NOT listed here and on any entry that no longer matches a violation — shrinking this file IS the fix; growing it needs a live issue.

Empty as of srs#668: the one entry (value_range.json, srs#534/srs#658) pinned its transition by commit SHA (fromCommit 3553f2ac, toCommit 72c5d2b7), and master's history was rewritten after those commits were made — 3553f2ac no longer exists as a git object at all, and 72c5d2b7 is no longer an ancestor of origin/master. The check can no longer observe two consecutive revisions of value_range.json to diff, so the entry stopped matching anything and the check's own remedy ("remove it — shrink discipline") applies. srs#658 stays open: the underlying semantic gap (no per-field version override in gen-metamodel-package.mjs) is unresolved, only the git-history-diff mechanism that once flagged it lost visibility.
